And "Ryan is Terry's descendant"? Actually "Terry is Ryan's descendant" means Ryan -> Terry. So Ryan is ancestor of Terry. So chain: Edward -> Ryan -> Terry -> Jonathan.

Thus we have two lines from Edward: one to Charlotte and then to Sean, and one to Ryan then to Jonathan. So Edward is a common ancestor of both Jonathan and Sean? So Edward is a common ancestor of Jonathan and Sean. That would mean Jonathan and Sean share a common ancestor (Edward). So option 1: Jonathan and Sean share a common ancestor.

But we need to check if there is any other relationship? Could it be that they are the same? No. Also check if there is any direct ancestor-descendant relation? Is Jonathan an ancestor of Sean?
